name: Kaman K-MAX K-1200
summary: A unique single-seat sling-load helicopter with twin intermeshing rotors and no tail rotor.

wings: Two intermeshing counter-rotating two-blade rotors on angled masts
fuselage: Narrow open-frame body behind the cockpit
tail: Slim tail boom with a small fin and horizontal stabilizers

tellTales: Two intermeshing rotors angled in a V
Narrow open-frame body with a single-seat pod

confusedWith.howToTell: The S-64 is much larger with a six-blade single rotor and twin engines; the K-MAX has two intermeshing rotors.
